about_the_game:
Hack, shoot, and survive the horde!

Choose from six unique heroes and fight your way through waves of enemies in this fast-paced twin-stick action roguelite. Level up, collect loot, and build your loadout with powerful weapons, consumables, and stat boosts. Unlock new heroes, expand your inventory, and prepare for epic boss battles.

Play Normal Mode or push your limits in Horde Mode to earn big rewards. Every run is different—adapt, upgrade, and dominate.

Features:

  • Fast-paced twin-stick hack & shoot gameplay

  • 6 heroes with unique weapons and playstyles

  • Randomized loot with evolutions and rarities

  • Upgrade gear and inventory between runs

  • Normal & Horde Modes + boss fights

  • Secrets and legendary loot to discover
